rows.note: This is the natural everyday choice for clothes that show more of the body than usual.

example.english: This dress is too revealing; I don’t think it’s suitable for work.
example.traditional: 呢條裙露得太多，我覺得唔係幾適合返工。
example.jyutping: ne1 tiu4 kwan4 lou6 dak1 taai3 do1 ngo5 gok3 dak1 m4 hai6 gei2 sik1 hap6 faan1 gung1

rows.note: Use this more general description when directly calling the clothing revealing rather than stressing that it shows too much.

example.english: If you wear this top to meet your elders, won’t it feel too revealing?
example.traditional: 你著呢件衫去見長輩，會唔會覺得太暴露呀？
example.jyutping: nei5 zoek3 ne1 gin6 saam1 heoi3 gin3 zoeng2 bui3 wui5 m4 wui5 gok3 dak1 taai3 bou6 lou6 aa3
